description: Na₃B₆NO₁₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.84 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.70 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.62 Å. There are four inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.34 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.36 Å) and two longer (1.37 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the third B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.43-1.53 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.51 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All N-O bond lengths are 1.26 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one N atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two B atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂B₂ tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one N atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three B atoms.
